Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:77219: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support

Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: ipv6: add NULL checks for idev in SRv6 paths (CVE-2026-23442)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Fix race condition in QP timer handlers (CVE-2026-45910)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Validate pad and ICRC before payload_size() in rxe_rcv (CVE-2026-46043)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Reject unknown opcodes before ICRC processing (CVE-2026-46133)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Reject non-8-byte ATOMIC_WRITE payloads (CVE-2026-46114)

* kernel: ipv6: exthdrs: refresh nh pointer after ipv6_hop_jumbo() (CVE-2026-63924)

* kernel: ipv6: exthdrs: refresh nh after handling HAO option (CVE-2026-63922)

* kernel: ipv6: validate extension header length before copying to cmsg (CVE-2026-63920)

* kernel: ipv6: rpl: fix hdrlen overflow in ipv6_rpl_srh_decompress() (CVE-2026-63984)

* kernel: Kernel SMB client: Double-free vulnerability allows remote denial of service or privilege escalation (CVE-2026-64385)

* kernel: smb: client: fix double-free in SMB2_flush() replay (CVE-2026-64383)

* kernel: smb: client: fix query_info() replay double-free (CVE-2026-64386)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Fix a use-after-free problem in rxe_mmap (CVE-2026-64582)

* kernel: ipv6: fix use-after-free in ip6_finish_output2() (CVE-2026-80792)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Fix responder UAF on IB_QP_MAX_DEST_RD_ATOMIC modify_qp (CVE-2026-80864)

* kernel: RDMA/rxe: Fix OOB in free_rd_atomic_resources() (CVE-2026-80863)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* gfs2: Remote delete issues [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-172430)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
